schemeScope: Combined Ordinary scheme. PDF 1–2 cover and note; 3 listening tariffs (and the only print of the 0–6 language deduction); 4–6 transcript (never shown to students); 7–9 listening answers, the Fógra a hAon grid answers printed after Fógra a Dó, ending with the mark-total boxes; 10–11 composition marking and the 40-mark table; 27–28 modified marking (SMM, incl. the composition 40-mark bands). PDF 12–26 are Paper 2; 29–32 blank.
reviewMethod: Every paper page (the 2020 Paper 1 is an 8-page question booklet; page 8 is blank) and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page; each listening prompt and scheme slice is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

nonPoolDecisions: Listening answers with alternatives (e.g. Ros Muc / I gConamara) are accepted answers to one task, not routes.

Card unit for listening: six segment cards, because the Bank plays one recording section as one exercise; every printed question is a separate criterion (20 questions at 3, the four Fógra a hAon grid questions included; 60 marks). Separate question cards are not added: they would repeat the same prompts inside that exercise.

Composition: closed choose-two of four sections; each printed title is a 50-mark card. Choice is not a route: no two-section combination cards are published; the choose-two instruction is in each title card’s task requirements. Letter/email, recipient (deartháir/deirfiúr) and conversation partner wording stay inside one response.
The modified marking scheme changes assessment for eligible candidates, not the printed tasks.
sourceFindings: Paper 1 = 160: listening 60 (Cuid A 24 = Fógra 1 12 + Fógra 2 12; Cuid B 24 = Comhrá 1 12 + Comhrá 2 12; Cuid C 12 = Píosa 1 6 + Píosa 2 6; every question 3 marks) and composition 100 (any two of A–D at 50: Tasc 2, Ábhar 8, Cumas Gaeilge 40).
Listening language: “Bainfear ó 0 go 6 ar chaighdeán na Gaeilge” is printed only on scheme PDF 3 in 2020; it is one section-level deduction, and cards state it without applying it.

Fógra a hAon is a printed grid (“Líon isteach an t-eolas atá á lorg sa ghreille anseo.”) of four unnumbered questions; the scheme prints their answers after Fógra a Dó on PDF 7, each as “answer 3 mharc” followed by alternatives. Each grid question is its own criterion (labelled Greille 1–4 in the app). The third grid question ends with a full stop, not a question mark.
The scheme text layer splits one tariff word on PDF 8 (Comhrá a hAon, An Dara Mír, Ceist 2: “3 mha rc”); the page prints “3 mharc”, and the builder rejoins it (asserted once).
The 2020 Ábhar text reads “idir na spreagthaí sa teideal a roghnaítear” and “nach bhfuil ad rem”; both are lifted as printed.
No 2020 card existed before this review; the 15 cards are new.
